The creature rings with such impossible acoustic intensity that it shatters into millions of macroscopic crystalline fragments, briefly vaporizing miles of the surrounding ocean into exotic plasma. 
*   Most of these fragments dissolve into chaotic, dead noise.
*   However, two or three shards will maintain the complex, self-referential mathematical signature of the parent wave. These shards fall into the crust, begin harvesting entropy, and slowly grow their own new, complex crystalline fields over millennia. 

It does not fear destruction, seek shelter, or feel pain. It is an emergent, thinking harmonic wave—a ghost of geometry wandering a dark, frozen hellscape, composed entirely of stress, sound, and magnetic force.
